Evidence boundary

The optimizer uses saved monthly ETF adjusted closes through October 19, 2026. LLY is a separately dated context signal, not an allocation sleeve. The 10% calendar-year-loss limit is disclosed but not coded because its measurement and breach response have not been defined.

Stop condition: stop if no feasible mix exists, a mandate rule fails, data timing cannot be defended, or the CIO rejects the loss-limit implementation.
